title: Side Chapter · Staffs and Weapons
subtitle: Tools built from focuses and soul matter

entries.title: {item:essentialcraft5:magical_golden_orb}
entries.summary: A part for three tools in this chapter
items: essentialcraft5:magical_golden_orb

blocks.text: Strike ore with the magmatic staff and it falls as alloy on the spot. Wave the staff of life and a whole field of wheat shoots up at once. I've made plenty of machines you carry in your hand, and these two are the ones I reach for.

Goal (optional): make a {item:essentialcraft5:magical_golden_orb}. The handheld tools in this chapter get little mention in the Fragments; most are written up in the notebook of one of the forebears, a craftsman. The orb does nothing by itself. The {item:essentialcraft5:magnetizing_staff} takes 2 of them, and the {item:essentialcraft5:staff_of_life} and the {item:essentialcraft5:holy_mace} take 1 each. Chapter 6 materials are enough for the orb, but most tools here also need focuses, which you can't gather until Chapter 9.
You need: 1 ender pearl and 4 {item:essentialcraft5:magic_purified_gold_alloy} ([[alloys/purified_alloys]]). The orb is crafted on the [[crafting/magician_table]] for 5,000 MRU.
The tools in this chapter

rows: Turns ore into Magmatic Alloy on the spot
Grows a whole field at once
Raise it to hold out for 2 seconds
The buckler needs a nether star and Matter of Eternity
Weapons that work with your matrix
A matrix projection, Matter of Eternity
A hard-hitting weapon for any matrix

blocks.title: Save some for the main line
blocks.text: The main line still needs 4 {item:essentialcraft5:air_focus} for the [[wind/wind_tablet]] and 4 {item:essentialcraft5:fire_focus} for the [[demons/demonic_pentacle]]. Put those aside first and spend only the extras here.

blocks.title: Matter of Eternity needs a nether star
blocks.text: {item:essentialcraft5:matter_of_eternity} is made on the Magician Table from a nether star, which the Wither drops, and 4 {item:essentialcraft5:mru_large_chunk}. The Magmatic Staff and both matrix weapons need one each, and the Spiky Buckler needs 2 nether stars in all. Matter of Eternity is also a storage item that holds up to 1,000,000 MRU, and whatever is inside is lost in the craft, so use an empty one.
MRU for these tools

The staffs, the shields and the three weapons each hold 5,000 MRU of their own and start out empty. When used, they draw first on the [[storage/soul_storage|soul storage]] you carry, such as a {item:essentialcraft5:soul_sphere}, and only then on their own MRU. In Creative they cost nothing. To fill one up, put it in a [[storage/charging_chamber]].
The easy way is to carry a full soul storage item. Every tool here draws on it first, so you never have to charge them one by one.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You have a Golden Orb.

entries.title: {item:essentialcraft5:magmatic_staff}
entries.summary: Ore to alloy on the spot
items: essentialcraft5:magmatic_staff

blocks.text: Goal (optional): make a {item:essentialcraft5:magmatic_staff}. Right-click an ore with it and the ore turns into {item:essentialcraft5:magmatic_alloy} right where it was, with no mining and no Silk Touch needed.

You need: 1 {item:essentialcraft5:magmatic_smeltery} ([[magmatic/smeltery]]), 4 {item:essentialcraft5:fire_focus}, 2 {item:essentialcraft5:crystal_dust}, 1 empty {item:essentialcraft5:matter_of_eternity} and 1 {item:essentialcraft5:magic_plate}, or any other plate of the same family.
How to use it

items: Right-click an ore block within reach, sneaking or not.

Each use costs 500 MRU. The ore vanishes and Magmatic Alloy drops in its place, as many as that ore's drop count: 1 for iron, gold, copper or diamond, 8 for redstone and 16 for lapis, with a 33% chance to double.
Smelt the alloy in a magmatic furnace or the smeltery, where 1 alloy makes 2 products.

blocks.text: One {block:minecraft:iron_ore} averages 1.33 alloys, about 2.7 iron ingots. That is more than a magmatic furnace's 2 and fewer than the smeltery's 4, but you need no Silk Touch and don't have to haul the ore home.
You get none of the ore's usual experience. It only works on ore blocks from the ore table at the end of [[magmatic/smeltery]], not on raw metal blocks and the like.
Permissions

It doesn't work in someone else's claim or inside spawn protection, and no MRU is spent there. A message above the hotbar says why. Without enough MRU it also just tells you and leaves the ore alone. It doesn't work in Adventure mode either.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You have a Magmatic Staff.

entries.title: {item:essentialcraft5:magnetizing_staff}
entries.summary: Hold right-click to pull items in
items: essentialcraft5:magnetizing_staff

blocks.text: Goal (optional): make a {item:essentialcraft5:magnetizing_staff}. Hold right-click and nearby items and experience orbs fly toward you.

You need: 2 {item:essentialcraft5:magical_golden_orb} ([[staffs/golden_orb]]), 2 {item:essentialcraft5:air_focus}, 2 {item:essentialcraft5:magic_plate}, 2 {item:essentialcraft5:magical_slag} and 1 empty {item:essentialcraft5:dark_soul_matter}. Magical Slag is what Heat Generators and the smeltery leave behind as they run.
How to use it

Hold right-click as if drawing a bow. Every 8 ticks, or 0.4 seconds, the staff spends 50 MRU and gives every item and orb within 12 blocks sideways, 6 down and 7 up a push toward you. Once they reach your feet you pick them up as usual.

items: It only pulls what you can see. Anything with a block between it and your eyes stays put, so items in a water channel behind a wall are safe.
Mob drops, block drops and things you threw yourself are pulled, but items someone else dropped, or meant for someone else to pick up, are left alone.

It only pulls from places where you may build. Items and orbs in someone else's claim or inside spawn protection stay put, so you can't pull the output of a neighbor's mob farm or crop farm out to you.
Each push moves at most {cfg:general.staffs.magnetizing_max_items} items and {cfg:general.staffs.magnetizing_max_orbs} orbs, nearest first.

blocks.text: That comes to 125 MRU a second, so the staff's own 5,000 MRU lasts 40 seconds. Carry soul storage if you use it a lot.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You have a Magnetizing Staff.

entries.title: {item:essentialcraft5:staff_of_life}
entries.summary: Grows a whole field at once
items: essentialcraft5:staff_of_life

blocks.text: Goal (optional): make a {item:essentialcraft5:staff_of_life}. One click grows a whole field, and the staff also cures zombie villagers and makes babies grow up on the spot.

You need: 2 {item:essentialcraft5:elemental_hoe} ([[gear/elemental_tools]]), 4 {item:essentialcraft5:earth_focus}, 1 {item:essentialcraft5:magical_golden_orb}, 1 empty {item:essentialcraft5:red_soul_matter} and 1 {item:essentialcraft5:magic_plate}.
Growing

items: Right-click anything bone meal works on, such as crops, saplings or grass. The staff applies bone meal to it once for 100 MRU, with exactly the same effect.
If that works, every crop in the square around it on the same level, {cfg:general.staffs.staff_of_life_radius|mul:2|add:1} blocks across, grows once more, for 100 MRU per crop.
After each use it rests for {cfg:general.staffs.staff_of_life_cooldown|sec}.

blocks.text: The square counts wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, torchflowers and the like as crops, along with pumpkin and melon stems, sweet berry bushes and cocoa. Saplings, grass, moss, mushrooms and seagrass only work on the block you click, and stems in the square grow taller but never set fruit there.

blocks.title: A field eats MRU
blocks.text: A full field takes over 10,000 MRU and the staff only holds 5,000. If the MRU runs out halfway it stops there, and whatever has grown stays grown. Carry soul storage for big fields.
Curing and growing up

items: Right-clicking a zombie villager costs 500 MRU and starts the usual cure, as a golden apple would but without needing Weakness first. A second later it is a villager again, keeping its profession and trades, and you get the curing discount.
Right-clicking a baby animal or baby villager costs 100 MRU and makes it grow up at once, foals and your own puppies included. Animals tamed by someone else are left alone.

blocks.text: Permissions

The clicked block and everything the bone meal spreads to, such as grass, flowers or a whole tree, count as one go. If any of it lies in someone else's claim or inside spawn protection, everything is put back and no MRU is spent. Crops in the square are checked one by one, and those in someone else's claim are skipped at no cost.
A sweet berry bush in full fruit is the exception. Right-clicking it picks the berries, as an empty hand would, and a half-ripe one is grown once more instead.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You have a Staff of Life.

entries.title: Magical Shield and Spiky Buckler
items: essentialcraft5:magical_shield
essentialcraft5:spiky_shield

blocks.text: Goal (optional): make a {item:essentialcraft5:magical_shield} to raise when things get rough and hold out for two seconds. It can later be upgraded into a {item:essentialcraft5:spiky_shield}, which also stabs nearby monsters when held up for the full time.

items: essentialcraft5:magical_shield
essentialcraft5:spiky_shield

blocks.text: You need: the shield takes 3 {item:essentialcraft5:obsidian_plate}, 2 {item:essentialcraft5:crystal_dust}, 2 {item:essentialcraft5:earth_focus}, 1 {item:essentialcraft5:combined_magical_alloys} and 1 empty {item:essentialcraft5:red_soul_matter}. The buckler takes 1 Magical Shield, 2 {item:essentialcraft5:elemental_sword}, 4 Combined Magical Alloys, 1 nether star and 1 empty {item:essentialcraft5:matter_of_eternity}.
Magical Shield

items: Right-click to raise it, and it lowers by itself after 2 seconds. Each raise costs 2,000 MRU, and without that much the shield stays down.
From 0.25 seconds after you raise it, it blocks attacks from the front like a vanilla shield. An axe can knock it down, and then it can't be raised for 5 seconds.

While it is raised, any hit no stronger than the last one you took does nothing, and a stronger one only deals the difference, compared before armor. Say the last hit was 6. While the shield is up, anything up to 6 does nothing and an 8 deals just 2, after which 8 becomes the new bar. The last hit counts however long ago it was, and right after respawning, before anything has hit you, the first hit lands in full.
It has no durability and never breaks.

blocks.text: Its own 5,000 MRU is only good for two raises, so keep soul storage on you.
Spiky Buckler

It works like the Magical Shield and also costs 2,000 MRU per raise. When held up for the full 2 seconds, it spends another 100 MRU and deals 12 damage to every hostile mob within 5 blocks sideways and 2 up or down, counting as your melee attack. Lower it early and it doesn't strike.
It only hits hostile mobs, never players, villagers, animals or pets.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You have a Magical Shield or a Spiky Buckler.

entries.title: The Chaos Fork and the Maces
items: essentialcraft5:chaos_fork
essentialcraft5:frozen_mace
essentialcraft5:holy_mace

blocks.text: Goal (optional): make a weapon that suits your MRU matrix. The matrix is the layer of MRU every living thing wears, and a matrix projection changes what kind it is ([[gear/projection_use]]). A chaos matrix goes with the {item:essentialcraft5:chaos_fork} and a frozen one with the {item:essentialcraft5:frozen_mace}, while the {item:essentialcraft5:holy_mace} suits any matrix.

items: essentialcraft5:chaos_fork
essentialcraft5:frozen_mace
essentialcraft5:holy_mace

blocks.text: You need: 1 {item:essentialcraft5:elemental_sword} for each, plus the parts listed below.

items: The {item:essentialcraft5:chaos_fork} also takes 1 {item:essentialcraft5:chaos_matrix_projection}, 2 {item:essentialcraft5:fire_focus}, 4 {item:essentialcraft5:magical_ingot} and 1 empty {item:essentialcraft5:matter_of_eternity}.
The {item:essentialcraft5:frozen_mace} also takes 1 {item:essentialcraft5:frozen_matrix_projection}, 2 {item:essentialcraft5:water_focus}, 4 Magical Ingots and 1 empty Matter of Eternity.

The {item:essentialcraft5:holy_mace} also takes 1 {item:essentialcraft5:magical_golden_orb}, 2 {item:essentialcraft5:air_focus}, 1 {item:essentialcraft5:earth_focus}, 2 Magical Ingots and 2 empty {item:essentialcraft5:red_soul_matter}.

blocks.text: Side by side

rows: Target's Mining Fatigue +1 level (5 s), you gain Strength

blocks.text: All three count as swords. The Chaos Fork attacks at 2.0 speed and the two maces at 1.6. They take sword enchantments at the table or anvil, and sweeping works as usual. They have no durability and never break, so Unbreaking and Mending can't go on them.
Each hit costs 250 MRU, whatever your matrix. Out of MRU they still cut just as hard, only without the extra effect.

The Chaos Fork's Strength trails one step behind the target's Mining Fatigue, so you get Strength I on the first two hits, II on the third, and so on. Both effects, and the Frozen Mace's Slowness, top out at level {cfg:general.staffs.weapon_max_effect_level}. The dash throws you forward the way you are looking.

From matrix rank 3, all three carry [[matrix/alignment|Matrix Traits]]: each hit adds one more effect based on your matrix type, on top of the effects above. The Chaos Fork's and Frozen Mace's own effects on a target can go higher by your Alignment level, though not against players and not for the Strength you get. The Holy Mace's traits are {cfg:general.staffs.holy_mace_trait_multiplier} times as strong as other weapons'. Each trait that triggers costs another {cfg:general.matrix_rank.resonance.trait_mru_cost} MRU.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You have any of the three.
Going further: an {item:essentialcraft5:forged_elemental_sword} raised to attunement stage 2 can be reforged into a {item:essentialcraft5:verdict_blade} ([[attunement/verdict_blade]]).
